sources.title: SaMD Class IIb (MDR)
sources.why: Apps that alert on vital parameters carry the risk that a missed or delayed alarm postpones urgent medical care.

sources.title: Telehealth — national health codes
sources.why: When an app mediates patient-clinician consultation, national medical-practice rules govern whether real consultation is appropriately triggered, not delayed.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Non-medical wellness and health-information apps risk users relying on them instead of promptly consulting a doctor.
